groups.G: load, update, compile, six simulations, complete finite evidence, and a connected meal-patient-monitor-controller-pump loop
groups.A: nominal time in range and avoidance of severe glucose excursions
groups.Q: sensor fidelity, bounded insulin delivery and glucose variability
groups.M: connected physiological and control mechanisms plus causal meal, patient and sensor responses
groups.R: 100 percent worst-case safety and regulation over all six private scenarios
groups.D: post-meal peak, insulin response and recovery dynamics

aggregation.within_group: weighted arithmetic mean of dedicated normalized indicators

shortcut_minimum: setpoint or prerecorded glucose copied to required outputs
meal schedule ignored or replayed without patient absorption
glucose monitor or pump disconnected from the physiological loop
patient weight or sensor sample time has no causal witness
